external_dependencies.name: MomusStudiofree / OpenCode local carryover

external_dependencies.name: Text → image → video provider credentials and models

security.provider_keys: Enter through the local application UI only for the current proof path.
security.network_boundary: Remain local-first until LAN-exposure and hardcoded-default risks are explicitly closed.

validation.proof_ceiling: Repository structure, ledger contract, manifest integrity, and absence of stale source-template filler. Local source provenance, provider connectivity, generation, audio/export, reproducibility, and network readiness require separate execution evidence.
